_readme: The FLOW ledger — what one ecosystem in a founder's project takes from another, declared so a check
can say when the two ends stop agreeing. Read by scripts/flows.js (check-refs class 7). IDEA-137 · C2;
WHY THIS EXISTS: IDEA-137's inventory (B1) found 44 flows between BOSS's ecosystems and six broken ones,
and all six were one shape — a path or a handover changed, and only one end noticed. /canvas writes
IDEA-NNN-canvas.md and seven readers kept opening CANVAS.md; at V1 the component index moved to
manifest.json and the reuse guard kept reading the old file and went silent. Nothing could see it,
because nothing said which file read which.
A TAKE is satisfied only when BOTH ends name the same path: the GIVER (a skill's own files) names it on
a line that writes it, and the READER (one shipped file) names it on a line that does not. Either end
moving alone breaks the take. The path is the truth of what the giver writes — declaring the reader's
stale path instead just moves the finding to the giver's side.
A SUCCESSION says a path is replaced at a rung; every reader of the old path must also read the new one.
Fields: reader (repo-relative file), path (a glob; NNN and <slug> in prose match *), from (the giving
skill's directory name), why (one line). 'store' and 'returns' come later (docs/ECOSYSTEMS.md).
